reviews.text: I saw Lea today for lowlights, highlights and a hair cut. She gave me exactly what I was hoping for. She’s super down to earth and easy to talk to. The salon is beautiful and the cost was very reasonable. Will definitely be back!

Everyone who works at Chameleon is talented, helpful, and kind! I've enjoyed every visit over the last twenty years and appreciate the caring and exceptional customer service I always receive. Thank you!

Always a pleasure going to Chameleon Salon! I have been going to Lisa for years and never had a bad style, cut or color! She is consistent with new style trends, treatments and always greets you with a smile! The staff and other stylists are friendly and always make you feel welcome! Highly recommend Chameleon! Ginab
